elements.title: Antimonumento +65 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Antimonumento +65 (pictured) bears the names of 65 miners who were trapped 19 years ago today and died during the Pasta de Conchos mine disaster?

elements.title: defence of Hennebont (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Joanna of Montfort became known as the "Flame of Brittany" after she led the successful defence of Hennebont against a besieging French army in 1342?

elements.title: Nagi Nemoto (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Nagi Nemoto made her VTuber debut on a classic television set?

elements.title: its second century of operation (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that National Hockey League players have not yet participated at the Olympics since the league entered its second century of operation?

elements.title: Swen Swenson (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Swen Swenson was born in Norway but pioneered a drainage system for Nicollet County while living in New Sweden?

elements.title: Alt Llobregat insurrection (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Alt Llobregat insurrection took place without any looting or killing?

elements.title: Devello Z. Sheffield (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Devello Z. Sheffield petitioned for the release of an assailant who had left him with over 30 wounds?

elements.title: Tkies-kaf (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the 1924 film Tkies-kaf had no director until its lead actor volunteered?

elements.title: Cave Rock, Sumner (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Māori-language name for Cave Rock, Sumner—Tuawera—means 'cut down as if by fire'?
